tenderSubEstimateList.subEstimateName: Raising of 8x12 size seedlings and Advance work at Kyasenahalli Beat Sy.74 - 25 Ha. of Jagalur Range During 2026-27

itemList.description: Survey and demarcation of Plantation boundary lines after clearing the rank growth to a width of 2 m. in the areas with sparse under growth.

Ripping along the contours at an appropriate interval to a depth of 75 cm, with a ripper attached to the bulldozer; the ripper having side flange attachment, which will rip open a trench to a width of 45 cm (on running meter basis). 500 Trenches or 2150 Rmtr.

Mechanical excavation of cattle proof trench of size top width 1.5 M. bottom 1.0 M. & vertical depth 1.0 M.with an initial lead up to 2 M. & depositing the excavated soil uniformly over the inner side of the CPT & forming conical mound of height 1.0 M.[including compacting the mound and hard soil or barbed wire fencing  as provided in the SSR item No. 86]
Raising  of 8"x12" size P.b Seedlings (1000+10% casuality Replacement)
Procurement of seeds of suitable local species for sowing on the mounds of the CPT during next rains.
Gully Checks/Boulder Bunds/Check Dam/SMC Works [As per measurement Continuous contour trench or specific SMC work]
